crew.overview: As a CODA (Child of Deaf Adults), Ruby is the only hearing person in her deaf family. When the family's fishing business is threatened, Ruby finds herself torn between pursuing her love of music and her fear of abandoning her parents.
crew.title: CODA

details.biography: Wren Stark Haven is a filmmaker living and working in Queens, New York. Her films center on working class women facing life’s big questions through a vibrant array of genres. As a veteran film sound technician and IATSE member, her credits include Oscar Best Picture winner CODA, Spirited, Free Guy, and Saturday Night Live. When she’s not working on films, she’s either racing bikes or cooking something lovely for her family.
details.name: Wren Stark Haven
